site_evidence.reference_definition: car_ground_z_map_m 是上述已定义运动参考点在本次静止记录中的 Vicon map Z。不是平台离地高度或物理几何中心高度；只在原控制适配器内部换算，不移动共同世界坐标。

car_origin_partial_estimate.full_offset_relation: car_body_origin_in_rigid_m = horizontal_contribution_in_rigid_m + h * body_up_axis_in_rigid; h is the unknown vertical offset in metres

car_motion_reference_definition.source: user horizontal estimate plus explicitly defined reference height
car_motion_reference_definition.target: virtual chassis motion reference, 15 mm forward of car01 origin at the same body-frame height

takeoff_capture.reuse_definition: same raw physical takeoff pose; control-reference origin and yaw recomputed with corrected body mapping; no recapture or new physical anchor

site_evidence.saved_landing_reference_definition: 复用此前正确摆放时无人机机体参考点相对当前定义车体参考的坐标；不是平台表面，也不替代底部支撑落脚范围。

route_design.shape: 3 m forward x 2 m left closed rectangle
route_design.frame: forward-left coordinates anchored once at the captured takeoff pose
route_design.heading_policy: constant physical car heading recomputed from saved takeoff raw pose and manual-forward calibration; no chassis turn at corners
route_design.note: 路线包络只代表车体参考点的路径；完整任务区域须覆盖无人机相对偏移、跟随偏差与机体外缘，不能把路径边界当净空边界。

user_site_confirmation.scope: corrected fixed start approach and complete forward3m-left2m-back3m-right2m rectangle; car outer clearance; personnel outside route; UAV remains off car

task_area_definition.method: axis-aligned bounds of fixed car route plus saved nominal UAV follow offset, expanded for reference braking
